query.name: stat-metrics
query.comment: Statistics about the last project build metrics (all projects)
query.sql: SELECT metric.metric, metric.name, metric.label, SUM(mb.value) AS value, MAX(mb.value) AS max_value, COUNT(mb.id) AS CNT FROM porion_last_build AS last_build INNER JOIN porion_build_metric AS mb ON mb.build_id = last_build.build_id INNER JOIN porion_metric AS metric ON mb.metric_id = metric.id WHERE last_build.status = 2 AND last_build.last_build = 1 GROUP BY metric.name

query.name: stat-project-metrics
query.comment: Statistics about the last project build metrics (specific project)
query.sql: SELECT metric.metric, metric.name, metric.label, SUM(mb.value) AS value, MAX(mb.value) AS max_value, COUNT(mb.id) AS CNT FROM porion_last_build AS last_build INNER JOIN porion_build AS build ON last_build.build_id = build.id INNER JOIN porion_build_metric AS mb ON mb.build_id = last_build.build_id INNER JOIN porion_metric AS metric ON mb.metric_id = metric.id WHERE last_build.status = 2 AND last_build.last_build = 1 AND build.project_id = :project_id GROUP BY metric.name

query.name: stat-project-with-metric
query.comment: Statistics about the last project build with a specific metric
query.sql: SELECT metric.metric, metric.name, metric.label, SUM(mb.value) AS value, MAX(mb.value) AS max_value, COUNT(mb.id) AS CNT FROM porion_last_build AS last_build INNER JOIN porion_build AS build ON last_build.build_id = build.id INNER JOIN porion_build_metric AS mb ON mb.build_id = last_build.build_id INNER JOIN porion_metric AS metric ON mb.metric_id = metric.id WHERE last_build.status = 2 AND last_build.last_build = 1 AND build.project_id = :project_id AND metric.metric = :metric GROUP BY metric.name

query.name: stat-build-metrics
query.comment: Statistics about the build metrics (specific build)
query.sql: SELECT metric.metric, metric.name, metric.label, SUM(mb.value) AS value, MAX(mb.value) AS max_value, COUNT(mb.id) AS CNT FROM porion_build AS build INNER JOIN porion_build_metric AS mb ON mb.build_id = build.id INNER JOIN porion_metric AS metric ON mb.metric_id = metric.id WHERE build.id = :build_id GROUP BY metric.name
